description: Read aggregated on-chain market state for a tokenized asset: pooled liquidity, 24h volume, transaction counts, and the individual pools behind those totals. Thin liquidity relative to supply is the usual reason a tokenized asset cannot be exited at its reference price.

asset.description: Registry symbol such as TSLAx, or any Solana mint address.

pools.description: How many pools to list, largest first.

name: get_token_market
title: Read DEX market state
